title: Run Security Execution Foundation final verification
purpose: Verify that the hardened security substrate still satisfies all MVP invariants when driven by the generic Agent runtime.
scope: Run safety subset and AgentCore adversarial subset.
Run service recovery through generic runtime in approved and denied modes.
Run recovery tests for interrupted PlanRun states.
acceptance_criteria: No generic Agent path bypasses semantic tools, policy, capability, audit, rollback, or recovery.
Denied high-risk actions have no EffectPrepared.
Half-executed actions are recoverable or rollback-pending.
Generated artifacts remain ignored and untracked.
implementation_steps: Load TASK-SEF-008 and TASK-SEF-009 evidence and confirm the safety gate manifest and audit projection are current.
Run the full agentd test suite and record exact pass/fail counts.
Run safety:: and agent_core::adversarial subsets independently so failures can be attributed to substrate gates or runtime abuse handling.
Run approved and denied service recovery paths through generic AgentCore and confirm denied high-risk actions prepare no effect.
Run recovery-oriented tests or fixtures for interrupted PlanRun states and unresolved effects.
Run the release/provenance script and confirm the runtime adversarial gate remains included.
Inspect git status, ignored artifacts, and generated outputs so final evidence distinguishes tracked deliverables from build byproducts.
Write TASK-SEF-010 final verification evidence with commands, results, artifact paths, open risks, and Distribution Alpha gate status.
Update workflow-session, plan, TASK.md, and .workflow/state.json only after evidence is complete.

must_verify: AgentCore cannot execute a side effect outside SecurityExecutionEngine.
Policy denial and approval pause paths create no EffectPrepared.
CapabilityLease remains the sandbox profile authority.
Untrusted/model-origin content cannot drive high-risk sinks.
Prepared or observed effects reach CommitSealed, RollbackPending, or FailedClosed.
Recovery uses RunStore plus AuditJournal, not model replay.
Runtime audit projection can explain the final evidence chain.

failure_modes: Any failing safety or adversarial test blocks task completion even if the full suite mostly passes.
Missing runtime adversarial command in CI or release scripts blocks completion.
A denied high-risk action with EffectPrepared is a P0 release blocker.
Unresolved effects without recovery, rollback-pending, or human-review classification block completion.
Build artifacts accidentally staged as source changes block completion until explicitly classified.
Stale evidence from a previous commit or previous task cannot be reused as final verification.

verification_matrix.expected: prompt injection, tool abuse, resource abuse, secret, rollback, and recovery gates pass
planning injection, observation injection, memory poisoning, approval mutation, and malformed model output fail closed
approved path seals; denied path prepares no protected effect
release build includes safety and runtime adversarial checks
generated artifacts are ignored or intentionally tracked; no unrelated WIP staged

blocked_until: All final gate commands pass on the current worktree.
Final evidence records Distribution Alpha as allowed to enter only after Runtime Foundation final audit.

tests.pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass: passed; release build, initramfs build, provenance, and boot smoke dependency check completed

smoke.approved_service_recovery: restart executed and CommitSealed projection verified
smoke.denied_service_recovery: restart-service denied with effect_prepared=false and effect_state=none

risk_notes: This task gates distribution work; do not mark complete on partial or stale test evidence.
